description: Prices of all Turkish cargo carriers for a parcel inside Türkiye, cheapest first. Only desi or weight is needed: the price is the same for every city and district, so one call covers all of Türkiye. No account needed. Signed-in prices can be lower (customer discounts). To ship, the user needs a Kargom account (kargom.com).

desi.description: Desi (Turkish volumetric weight = length×width×height cm / 3000). Sellers often give only desi; then weight and size are not needed

to_city.description: Optional. Destination il; price does not change by city

name: get_shipping_prices
title: Compare cargo prices
